warnings: Steel members printed with channel glyphs (⊓ / ⊔ / ⊐⊏) and four numbers '100x50x50x3.2' — recorded designation C (2C for the back-to-back pair) with d 100 / b 50 / t 3.2; the third number (50) has no key in §6a for this family and stays only in printed_as.
Purlin spacing printed @0.90-1.00 m: spacing_mm = the smaller (900) + variable_spacing (§0.5). A trailing alternative after "หรือ" is illegible.

Truss members have no printed marks — element_id null with element_name_assigned. The รูปตัด ข-ข / แสดงการต่อเชื่อม sketch at the right edge repeats ⊐ 100x50x50x3.2, L-40x40x3.2 สลับข้าง and a 4 mm gusset — no new member, not extracted separately.
Truss heights / spans (2.05, 1.60, 10.00, 1.20, 0.35) are also transcribed in the grid master.
